Name: PickUpClutter
Author: MaxMakesMods
Description:
I created this mod while fixing my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]DeepWoods [/url]mod and encountering a bug that allowed picking up rocks, twigs, and weeds. After figuring out the cause of the bug, someone suggested in a comment to make a mod that adds the bug as a feature. And here we are.

Note that this mod is mostly a tech demonstration/tutorial with plenty bugs. A better alternative is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url].

I made a video where I create this mod from scratch so you can learn how: [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/141556688]https://www.patreon.com/posts/141556688[/url]

See the source code here: [url=https://github.com/maxmakesmods/pickupclutter]https://github.com/maxmakesmods/pickupclutter[/url]

Manifest.Description: Allows to pickup and relocate clutter
